dct_title_s: Surface Waters Monitoring In Pakistan - Evolution - 17 May 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20221121PAK** Status: Overall decrease in the observed surface waters Further action(s): continue monitoring Evolution of Cumulative Surface Waters over I.R. of Pakistan (21 to 25 Apr. 2023) Vs. (26 to 30 Apr. 2023) Between 26 to 30 April 2023 approximately 1 million people are potentially exposed or living close to maximum floodwaters areas(*); Approximately 230,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to minimum floodwaters areas(**) between 26 to 30 April 2023; Based on satellite observations between 21 to 25 April 2023 and compared with observations between 26 to 30 April 2023, the maximum flood water extent appears to continue to retract with approximately ~ -3,700 km² in Sindh, ~ - 1,500 km² in Punjab, ~ -160 km²  in Balochistan and ~ - 180 km²  in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
